nodes.title: bay
nodes.equation: x_fs = pod LE + t + bond line + t_fs (forward stop aft face); nose to stop = x_fs - pod LE; bay L = x_as - x_fs; H = (base + H - t) - (base + t + floor stack); x_nose_in = pod LE + t; nose block = (x_fs - t_fs) - x_nose_in; centroid against the forward stop = x_fs + L_pack/2 ; nominal / heavy centroid = aft face - L_pack/2 ; spacer = x_as - aft face ; block B (nominal) = (aft_nom - L_pack - t_sp) - x_fs ; block section = bw (zh - top gap - tray top) - groove w x d ; over the fore-top step = bw (zh - top gap - step d - tray top) - groove w x max(groove d - step d, 0) ; aft reach = x_as - filler - L_pack/2 ; spacer = x_as - filler - aft face (D-174) ; travel = bay L - L_pack ; pack z = zp + foam spacer + H_pack/2 (E2 D-163; bay H stays pad top to hatch)

nodes.title: station
nodes.equation: most forward centroid that keeps block B = x_fs + t_sp + max(C5's L_B, A1's D-150 block 31.0 mm) + L_pack/2 ; station range = aft reach - that ; spacer sum >= range

nodes.title: fwd room
nodes.equation: forward trim room at the nominal station = nominal centroid - most forward centroid with block B

nodes.title: recess
nodes.equation: x0: upper surface z(x) = pod base; depth = z(x_end) - base, x_end = spar x - r - wall; foam under = base - lower surface z(x_end)

nodes.title: cad
nodes.equation: read-outs of pod.py#layout(): pad clearance, antenna A / B to pack, GPS to nearest power item, wire channel and crossing (F2)

nodes.title: pod bonds
nodes.equation: capacity = bonded area x epoxy-on-paper shear allowable

nodes.title: pack stations
nodes.equation: per pack m (546 g, 590 g acceptance line, 550 g): spacer = round_2mm(x_as - (x_target + L_pack/2)); x = x_as - spacer - L_pack/2; block B = (x - L_pack/2 - t_sp) - x_fs; block B min = CL-C5-BLOCK-L x m / 551 g (crush energy ~ m); x_as less the D-174 aft filler

nodes.title: stack
nodes.equation: pack on the crush stack: x = x_fs + L_B + t_sp + L_pack/2 ; gap to the aft stop = x_as - (x + L_pack/2) ; spacer that fits = floor(gap / step) x step ; play = gap - spacer ; same with C5's block

nodes.title: r6 geom
nodes.equation: read-outs of pod.py#layout() for the D-69 fixes: strut rib free length = bridge front - pad back; rib to skin = rib underside - max wing surface under it; bracket flange area per side; stop-T flange area under the floor; antenna B tube end x; D-74: pod bodies in the power-board keep-outs, outboard side room, pod bodies in the XT30U zones, XT30U exit clearance; D-150: hatch swing gap to the crush block, lowest tongue z

nodes.title: pdb pad
nodes.equation: flat-wise moment capacity of the ribbed PDB plate (rigid pad) = sigma x b x L^2 / 6 ; RF = capacity / unplug moment

nodes.title: straps
nodes.equation: capacity = n straps x installed loop capacity

nodes.title: pod crash
nodes.equation: F = (pod + avionics + power - nominal pack + acceptance-line pack) x n_crash x g

nodes.title: ties
nodes.equation: capacity = n ties x tie rating

nodes.title: handle
nodes.equation: F_ult = gate mass x g x handling factor x ultimate factor

nodes.title: pitot
nodes.equation: boom length = socket inner end - tip x; exposed = pod LE - collar - tip x

nodes.title: mast bolt
nodes.equation: past the grip = screw length - grip ; C6 E-POD-06 min engagement 4.0 mm (PA66 nut fully on + 2 pitches)

nodes.title: mass
nodes.equation: pod mass = sum of the CAD part masses
